hooks.command: fp='d0254311f7ad5526ae982b9f13695a42642c2ae6987d74cebc374e0d93c82944'; guard_seen=; cd "$HOME/.local/share/ai-collab-kit/guard/$fp" >/dev/null 2>&1 && guard_odd="$(/usr/bin/env -i /usr/bin/find . ! -path . ! \( -path ./tools -type d \) ! \( -path ./settings.json -type f -size -1048576c \) ! \( -path './tools/*' -type f -size -1048576c \( -name forbidden-tools.js -o -name package.json -o -name settings-data.js \) \) 2>/dev/null)" && case "$guard_odd" in "") guard_sum="$(/usr/bin/env -i /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 settings.json tools/forbidden-tools.js tools/package.json tools/settings-data.js 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/env -i /usr/bin/shasum -a 256)" && guard_seen="|$guard_sum";; esac; case "$guard_seen" in "|$fp  -") ;; *) echo '禁區攔截器的固定複本不在這台機器上、被改過、裡面多了東西（連結、不是一般檔的東西、不小於 1 MiB 的檔也算；或查不了裡面有什麼）、或佔位沒換（指紋對不上）：一律當成拒絕。不要手工造複本、不要自己改那一行，原句轉給裁示者（補複本的順序在 tools/guard-copy.js 檔頭）' >&2; exit 2;; esac; /usr/bin/env -i PATH="$PATH" node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main tools/forbidden-tools.js || { echo '禁區攔截器起不來（找不到檔、沒有 node、載入就崩）：一律當成拒絕' >&2; exit 2; }
